visualizations.summary: 同一个十九点贝伦德球壳 x² + y² + z² = 867 上的五张卡。球壳枚举、弦距、三角形、24 × 24 相位网格上的五荷谱、第七时间的大整数括号与 W_K 和乐由脚本现算（NUM）；三条高度带的份额、绕数门槛、记忆秩阶梯与 ShellProjection.lean 的摘要是随页面打包、取自 trureturing-experiments 的第四层复算证书（NUM），不由脚本现算，也未在 trureturing 冻结。球壳：枚举得到恰好 19 个正整点，极点 (17, 17, 17) 加六条坐标轮换轨道；30 种平方弦距中 d² ≤ 804 的 23 种给出 135 条边与 529 个三角形，两只弦钟的频率是 θ₇₂₄ − θ₂₄₄ 与 θ₈₀₄ − θ₂₄₄，三点组给出 det G₃ = det(a, b, c)²/867³ 与有向立体角。谱隙：五种荷 q = 1, 2, −3, −4, 6 的磁拉普拉斯按循环特征标分块对角化，每荷三个轻模各带 1、ω、ω²，λ₃ < 8.685 < 9.6 < λ₄；站点方差分界 T = 10 在部分相位放进第四个模。算术钟：六个 44 位输入格用大整数分数给出 2³⁵F₇ 的括号，落在同一个整数格 32071996606，43 位时跨两格；三条高度带的算术权按证书标出。绕数阶梯：证书门槛 18、19、21、27、31、36、105 与 529 个三角面第 K 圈威尔逊项。记忆秩：弦距截止 D 从 0 到 1600，证书给出的辅助记忆秩从 38 降到 19，512 处时钟数从 9 变为 10。三点组读数旁的两个绿色框是正文引用的冻结定理：三枚非零整四元数的 detGram3 ≥ 0，以及三向量格拉姆行列式的展开；文献结果与手工推导标 ARGUED，画法标 MODEL，未决问题标 OPEN。
visualizations.summary_en: Five cards on one 19-point Behrend shell x² + y² + z² = 867. The shell enumeration, chords, triangles, five-charge spectra on a 24 × 24 grid of phases, big-integer brackets of the seventh time and W_K holonomies are computed live by the script (NUM); the three-band shares, winding thresholds, memory-rank staircase and the summary of ShellProjection.lean are bundled Tier-4 replay certificates from trureturing-experiments (NUM), not computed by the script and not frozen in trureturing. Shell: the enumeration gives exactly 19 positive integer points, the pole (17, 17, 17) and six orbits of the cyclic shift; of 30 squared chord lengths the 23 with d² ≤ 804 give 135 edges and 529 triangles, the two chord clocks run at θ₇₂₄ − θ₂₄₄ and θ₈₀₄ − θ₂₄₄, and a triad gives det G₃ = det(a, b, c)²/867³ and its signed solid angle. Gap: the magnetic Laplacians of the five charges q = 1, 2, −3, −4, 6 are diagonalised block by block in the cyclic characters; each charge keeps three light modes carrying 1, ω, ω², with λ₃ < 8.685 < 9.6 < λ₄, while the site-variance cut T = 10 admits a fourth mode at some phases. Arithmetic clock: six 44-bit input cells bracket 2³⁵F₇ in big-integer fractions inside the single integer cell 32071996606, two cells at 43 bits; the arithmetic weights of the three height bands are shown as certified. Winding ladder: the certified thresholds 18, 19, 21, 27, 31, 36, 105 beside the K-th winding term of the 529 triangles. Memory rank: as the chord cutoff D runs from 0 to 1600 the certified auxiliary memory rank falls from 38 to 19, and at 512 the clock count changes from 9 to 10. The two green boxes beside the triad readings are frozen theorems the text cites: detGram3 ≥ 0 for three nonzero integer quaternions and the expansion of the Gram determinant of three vectors; literature results and hand derivations are marked ARGUED, drawing conventions MODEL and unsettled questions OPEN.
